title: 'Something in the Reed-Cuts' (eel-trader bounty, plus the Warden-marked 'take it on as your own watch') never resolved despite exploring what appeared to be the entire Fenmarch fen map and killing the one obvious candidate (the bloated drowned wight in Sunken Howe) — the quest stayed permanently open with no further clue toward a trigger.
